summary: Regression + new-features (Slack tool + Meeting History) tested for AutoDelegate. All 19 backend pytest tests pass (13 regression + 6 new: slack routing action produced, jira+calendar co-routing, execute slack demo returns provider=slack/demo=true/MSG-xxxx/SIMULATED, GET /api/meetings returns list with required fields sorted newest-first and excludes raw_transcript/_id, edit-action accepts action_type='slack'). Frontend E2E: History button opens history-panel showing 10 past meetings; clicking a history item loads it into Analysis view (Slack badge visible on Priya action from a previously-analyzed meeting) and closes the panel. Fresh happy-path with the slack transcript produced 3 actions with correct routing (jira / slack / calendar), edit-action-dialog Tool select exposes 'Slack' as an option, approve-all + execute-all in demo mode ran cleanly showing SIMULATED cards including a Slack card with MSG-xxxx id and #team-updates channel.

issues: History button hidden on <sm screens (hidden sm:inline-flex) - mobile users cannot access history
Radix DialogContent still missing DialogDescription/aria-describedby (a11y warning) - carried over from iteration 1

action_items: Optional: expose History button on mobile (drop hidden sm:inline-flex or add a mobile icon-only variant).
Optional: MeetingHistory StatusBadge mapping conflates 'analyzed' -> 'approved' badge which can be misleading before user approves anything; consider a distinct 'analyzed' variant.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py GET /api/meetings uses to_list(50) — hard-coded limit without pagination; fine for MVP but should be parameterized.
MeetingHistory.jsx: no error state UI (catch sets []); users see 'No meetings yet' on API failure. Consider surfacing a toast on load failure.
App.js handleSelectHistory: sets step to 'execution' if ANY action has execution_result, even failed ones — acceptable but could show 'analysis' when nothing succeeded.
integrations.create_slack_message: real branch posts webhook but simulated branch always returns success=True; consistent with other tools.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all critical flows including new History + Slack)

seed_data_creation: Additional TEST_slack_routing meeting created via pytest run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Slack routing verified with phrase 'post a project update to the team channel' -> action_type=slack. Meeting History panel testid is history-panel, items are history-item-{i}. Backend list endpoint strips raw_transcript and _id. Allow up to 30s for /api/analyze-meeting (LLM).
